snippet.title: 10K & The Kriminal World - Sammy's Attack // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578380/10K__The_Kriminal_World__Sammys_Attack

"10K & The Kriminal World - Sammy's Attack" is a 2D side-scrolling action game with comics style and multi controllable characters. Players can explore stages with enemies and platforming challenges.

Developed by
Neverland Digital Entertainment
